get.description:
`google` is true only when the server has Google OAuth credentials; email and password always
work. `registration` is who may sign up: `open` (anyone), `invite` (with an invite code, during
the private beta) or `closed`.

registration.description: The enum itself (serialised as its value), so the API contract lists the three modes.

get.description: Prices, public limits and features only — never internal guards, costs or the credit markup.

get.summary: The languages a workspace can translate into (BCP-47)

get.description:
The link from the email: its signature and the address hash prove it, so no sign-in is needed.
Redirects into the app.

examples: This verification link is not valid.

get.summary: The workspace's feeds, each with its latest import

post.description:
With a URL the first download starts at once; without one the feed waits for an upload. The
plan's feed limit applies: over it, a 402 names the plan that fits. With `upload_size`, the
first file must also fit the plan's feed size (402), checked before anything is made.

get.summary: A feed with its latest import

patch.summary:
Rename a feed, change its URL or its reading options (owner or admin). What is not sent is
kept: an omitted URL never clears the stored one

delete.summary: Delete a feed with its imports and stored files (owner or admin)

get.summary: A feed's last 20 imports, newest first
An import in full: how the file was read, its column profile, samples and warnings

post.summary:
Read an import's stored file again with corrected options (encoding, delimiter, quoting,
XML item). The options are saved on the feed for its next imports

get.description: `200` when the database answers, `503` when it does not.
404 `no_profile` until the feed has a profiled import.
get.summary: The mapping of the feed's current columns, drafted for free (no AI) on first view

patch.summary:
Say which language the feed is written in (owner or admin): its text fields are filed under
it. 409 on a stale version, 422 for a language outside the registry

put.summary:
Set one field (owner or admin): a column, a composition, or empty. It is checked like every
suggestion: a refused edit is stored as refused, with the reason. 409 on a stale version

post.summary:
Ask the AI for a better mapping (owner or admin), optionally with corrections in words. The
worst case is reserved from the workspace's credits first; 409 `insufficient_credits` with
the numbers when they do not cover it, 409 `ai_unavailable` when AI is off

instructions.description: Corrections for the AI, in the seller's words.

message.const: AI suggestions are not available right now.

post.summary: Approve the mapping (owner or admin): it needs the SKU and one text field (422 otherwise)

post.description:
The answer is identical whether or not the address has an account, and whether or not the
request was throttled (legacy defect D19: the old answer revealed which addresses exist).

status.const: If an account exists for this address, we have emailed a link to reset the password.

post.description: Signs the account out everywhere: every session and "remember me" cookie stops working.
post.summary: Reset the password with the emailed token

status.const: Your password has been reset. You can sign in now.

put.summary: Change your name or interface language

put.description: Every other session of the account is signed out.
put.summary: Change your password (or set a first one after signing up with Google)

post.description:
Creates the account and its own workspace, signs the person in (unverified) and emails the
verification link. In the private beta an invite code is required.

One answer for every failure (unknown address, wrong password, Google-only account), and
Laravel's timebox keeps the response time the same, so the endpoint cannot tell which
addresses have accounts.

post.summary: Sign out and end the session

get.summary: What the feed will translate, into which languages, how much work that is and its estimate in credits

put.summary:
Choose each text field's mode and the target languages (owner or admin). Languages must be
the workspace's own; 409 on a stale version

target_locales.description: BCP-47 codes of the workspace's languages.

post.summary:
Start translating the plan as shown (owner or admin): kept fields and the memory's repeats
are written at once; the rest is queued as AI work, within the plan's allowance. 409 on a
stale version

get.summary: The state of two-factor sign-in for this account and this session. Never the secret

post.summary: Start setting it up: a new secret, as a QR code and as text for manual entry
Finish setting it up with a first code. The recovery codes are shown only now
Prove the second factor for this session: an app code or a recovery code
New recovery codes (the old ones stop working). Needs the second factor in this session

Start a chunked upload of a feed file. A file larger than the plan reads answers 402 with the
plan that reads it; larger than this server reads at all, 422

put.summary:
Send one chunk as the raw request body (`application/octet-stream`). Chunks may arrive in any
order and be sent again; each must have exactly its expected length

post.summary: Complete the upload: the chunks are assembled, checked and imported

get.summary: The workspace: plan in force, limits, usage and target languages

put.description:
The list replaces the current one and must fit the plan: otherwise a 402 names the plan that
would fit. Concurrent changes are serialised on the workspace row, so two requests can never
together exceed the limit.
put.summary: Set the target languages (owner or admin)

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the whole file, when the client computed it: a corrupted upload is caught here.

profile_import_id.description: The import whose profile is current (the last one read successfully); it stays while a later import fails.

mapping_status.description:
The mapping of the current columns: null until the feed has a profile and the mapping
was first viewed (that drafts it).

FieldClass.description: How a canonical field is treated (ADR 0003).
FieldClass.title: FieldClass

FieldKind.description: How a field's values are checked (the mapping's FieldValidator).
FieldKind.title: FieldKind

Format.description: What a feed's rows are written in, after any gzip or zip around it is removed.
Format.title: Format

can_reread.description: The received file is stored, so it can be read again with other options.

version.description: Send it back with every change: an edit on an older version is refused (409).

unavailable_reason.description: Why a suggestion cannot be asked for now: ai_disabled, unpriced_model, provider_unavailable.

estimate_credits.description: The most a suggestion can cost, in credits; usually far less is used.

protected.description: Prices, stock, ids, images, weights: never shown to the AI, never in a text field.

candidate_column.description: What was suggested and refused, when the field was left empty.

feed_bytes.description: The largest feed one import reads, uncompressed.

invite_code.description:
Required in the private beta; checked by the invite itself so a missing and a wrong
code get the same answer.

RegistrationMode.description: Who may create an account (config feedgenix.registration).
RegistrationMode.title: RegistrationMode

RereadImportRequest.description: Read the same file again with corrected options (encoding, delimiter, quoting, XML item).
RereadImportRequest.title: RereadImportRequest

StartUploadRequest.description: Start a chunked upload. Whether the size fits the plan is checked next (402 or 422, FeedSizeLimit).
StartUploadRequest.title: StartUploadRequest

url.description: Without a URL the feed is fed by uploads.

upload_size.description:
The size of the first file to upload, when known: a file the plan cannot read is
refused before the feed is made, so nothing is left behind.

version.description: Send it back with a change: a save on an older version is refused (409).

saved.description: False until someone saves it: these are the defaults.

texts.description: Texts with no fresh translation yet.

memory.description: Of those, repeats the translation memory covers at no cost.

unavailable_reason.description: Why there is no estimate: ai_disabled, unpriced_model, provider_unavailable.

at_most_credits.description: The most it can cost; each call reserves its share first.

UpdateFeedRequest.description: Only what is sent changes: an omitted URL keeps the stored one (legacy D16).
UpdateFeedRequest.title: UpdateFeedRequest

UpdateMappingFieldRequest.description: Set one field of a mapping: a column, a composition of columns, or nothing.

column.description: The column that fills it alone; omit both column and recipe to leave it empty.

UpdateMappingFieldRequest.title: UpdateMappingFieldRequest

UpdatePasswordRequest.description:
Change the password (the current one is required), or set a first one for an account that has
only ever signed in with Google.
UpdatePasswordRequest.title: UpdatePasswordRequest

UpdateProfileRequest.description: A person may change their name and interface language — nothing else about their account.
UpdateProfileRequest.title: UpdateProfileRequest

UpdateWorkspaceLanguagesRequest.description:
The full set of target languages (it replaces the current one). Codes are matched to the
registry case-insensitively ("PT-br" → "pt-BR") and duplicates collapse.
UpdateWorkspaceLanguagesRequest.title: UpdateWorkspaceLanguagesRequest

ValueKind.description: What a column's values look like, from a sample of them. Mapping (M3) uses it as evidence; it never changes a value.
ValueKind.title: ValueKind

feed_bytes.description: What one import reads here, uncompressed: the plan's limit within the server's.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
A detailed description of each field that failed validation.

PlanLimitExceeded.description: A plan limit was reached, or the feature is part of a higher plan

limit.description: The limit key or feature, e.g. "languages".

requested.description: What the action would have brought usage to.

upgrade_to.description: The cheapest plan that fits, or null (talk to us).

message.description: A sentence for the person, naming the numbers.
